title: Week 9 · Unit 9 资产负债表
intro: 本周学资产负债表（Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position）：某一时点企业拥有什么（资产）、欠什么（负债）、属于所有者的是多少（权益）。核心等式 A = L + OE，或写成 A − L = 净资产 = OE。每张表都分流动、非流动；所有者权益 = 期初资本 + 净利润 − 提款。下面每张资产负债表都由程序加总，并核对两边相等。

sections.title: 分类资产负债表（Classified Balance Sheet）
sections.concept: 资产负债表反映某一时点的财务状况，标题写「as at 30 June 20XX」。 流动资产：现金、应收账款、期末存货、预付费用、物料，1 年或一个营业周期内变现或用掉。非流动资产：土地、房屋、机器设备、车辆、家具，按成本列示并减去累计折旧。 流动负债：应付账款、应付工资、透支、应付利息、预收收入，1 年内偿还。非流动负债：5 年期贷款、抵押贷款。 所有者权益：期初资本 + 净利润（亏损则减）− 提款。利润表的净利润就是这样连到资产负债表上的。 两种竖式格式：A = L + OE（资产合计等于负债加权益合计），或 A − L = 净资产 = OE。也可以用左右对照的 T 式。 利润表里的项目（收入、费用）不进资产负债表；资产负债表只用期末存货。
formulas: Assets = Liabilities + Owner's Equity　　Net Assets = Total Assets − Total Liabilities = Owner's Equity
Owner's Equity = Capital + Net Profit − Drawings

examples.label: 例 1
examples.question: Explain: Balance Sheet; Net Assets.
examples.solution: Balance Sheet：资产负债表，列示某一时点的资产、负债和所有者权益，A = L + OE，并分流动和非流动。 Net Assets：净资产 = 总资产 − 总负债，等于所有者权益。

examples.label: 例 2
examples.question: Kingsford Trading balance sheet as at 31 July 20XX: Cash 1,940; Stock 9,200; A/R 3,110; Stationery Supplies 30; Prepaid Advertising 104; Motor vehicle 21,800 less accumulated depreciation 550; A/P 10,950; Accrued Wages 100; Bank Loan 10,000; Capital 1 July 12,900; Net Profit 1,984; Drawings 300. Present it in A = L + OE and A − L = OE formats.
examples.solution: 同一组数字两种格式：竖式 A = L + OE 时资产 35 634 = 负债 21 050 + 权益 14 584；A − L = OE 时净资产 14 584 = 权益 14 584。

figures.title: Kingsford Trading Balance Sheet as at 31 July 20XX
Kingsford Trading Balance Sheet as at 31 July 20XX (A − L = OE format)

examples.sourceNote: 阅读材料这里的净利润是 1 984、提款 300，而第 8 周 Kingsford 的利润表算出 1 684、试算表的提款是 0；两份材料数字不一致，各自内部是平衡的。

examples.label: 例 3
examples.question: Lecture version: Motor vehicle 41,250 less accumulated depreciation 10,000; A/P 21,050; Loan 10,000; Capital 12,900; Net Profit 1,900; Drawings 216 (other current assets as above). Show A − L = Net Assets = OE.
examples.solution: 讲义版本的数字又不同，但同样平衡：资产 45 634 − 负债 31 050 = 净资产 14 584 = 权益 14 584。

figures.title: Kingsford Trading Balance Sheet as at 31 July 20XX (lecture version)

examples.label: 例 4
examples.question: Abbey Traders (trial balance in Week 8, with closing inventory $10,000, depreciation $3,000, interest payable $2,000; net profit $17,000): prepare the balance sheet (also the unit9 lecture exercise.xlsx template).
examples.solution: 累计折旧 5 000 + 3 000 = 8 000；应付利息 2 000 是流动负债；净利润 17 000 加到资本上。与讲义答案 p15 一致。

figures.title: Abbey Traders Balance Sheet as at 31 December 20XX

examples.label: 例 5
examples.question: Lynn Trading, 30 June: Cash 12,500; Closing inventory 21,000; A/R 7,290; Motor vehicle 86,400; Office Equipment 75,000; Accumulated depreciation – MV 10,000; – office equipment 2,000; A/P 4,800; Mortgage Loans 70,000. Capital $77,700; drawings $1,100; net profit $38,790. Prepare the balance sheet in T-format and vertical formats.
examples.solution: 每项非流动资产各自减去自己的累计折旧。净资产 115 390 = 77 700 + 38 790 − 1 100。下面给出 A − L = OE（模板格式）和 A = L + OE 两种竖式；T 式就是把资产放左边、负债和权益放右边，数字相同。

examples.question: Lou's Advertising Agency, trial balance 31 December: Cash 31,000; A/R 60,200; Art Supplies 14,000; Prepaid insurance 7,000; Printing Equipment 168,000; Accumulated depreciation 80,000; A/P 14,000; Interest Payable 420; Unearned revenue 15,680; Salaries payable 3,640; Bank Loan 5-year 14,000; Capital 56,000; Advertising revenue 172,200; Salaries 31,640; Insurance 2,380; Interest 1,400; (second line labelled Interest Expense) 19,600; Depreciation 9,520; Rent 11,200. Prepare the balance sheet (calculate net profit first).

examples.label: 例 7
examples.question: Wellington Wall Coverings Pty Ltd (items from Week 8 self-study 1): prepare a classified statement of financial position at 30 June 2021, given a net profit of $8,000.
examples.solution: 只用资产、负债、权益项目：期末存货 20 000 是流动资产；预收租金 2 000 是流动负债；累计折旧 14 000 从房屋中扣除；银行贷款列为非流动负债。权益 = 股本 160 000 + 净利润 8 000 = 168 000 = 资产 291 000 − 负债 123 000。

figures.title: Wellington Wall Coverings Pty Ltd Statement of Financial Position as at 30 June 2021

lines.label: Add Net profit for the year

examples.sourceNote: 原表有一行（期初留存收益）被涂黑；按其余数字倒推，它的金额是 0。题目没说银行贷款的期限，这里按非流动负债处理。

mistakes: 把期初存货放进资产负债表：只用期末存货。
累计折旧加到资产上：要减去。
把收入、费用、Unearned Revenue 弄混：前两者进利润表，预收收入是负债。

faqs.q: 资产负债表为什么叫「as at」？
faqs.a: 它是某一天结束时的快照；利润表是一段期间，所以用「for the year ended」。

faqs.q: 净利润为什么出现在资产负债表上？
faqs.a: 利润属于所有者，期末加到所有者权益里，这样两张表就连起来了。

sections.title: 综合练习：先利润表，再资产负债表
sections.concept: 综合题的顺序：①从试算表挑出收入和费用编利润表，算出净利润；②其余账户编资产负债表，权益 = 资本 + 净利润 − 提款；③核对 A = L + OE。两张表通过净利润相连，算错利润，资产负债表就不会平。

examples.label: 例 8
examples.question: 1. Phil Trading, 30 June: Sales 20,400; Sales returns 500; Purchases 6,140; Purchases returns 140; Discounts received 120; Freight in 200; Shop salaries 3,500; Office salaries 1,250; Advertising 2,400; Rent 250; Insurance 150; Electricity 175; Shop stationery 300; Office stationery 125; Depreciation – shop equipment 105; – office equipment 80; inventory $3,400 at the beginning, $2,600 at the end. Prepare the P&L. 2. 2. T 式：左边资产合计 628 469，右边负债 428 600 + 权益 199 869 = 628 469。第 2 题给的净利润是 54 869，与第 1 题无关（两题数据独立）。

examples.label: 例 9
examples.question: Excel practice 2 (8 & 9): (a) prepare income statements for Company a and Company b (b's figures are 3 × a's: Sales 20,000/60,000; Sales returns 2,000/6,000; Purchases 7,000/21,000; Purchase returns 1,000/3,000; Closing stock 1,500/4,500; Opening stock 500/1,500; Freight in 250/750; Freight out 200/600; Discount received 300/900; Interest received 700/2,100; Interest expense 1,000/3,000; Wages 3,000/9,000). (b) Superquick Couriers: from the trial balance prepare the statement of profit or loss and the statement of financial position at 30 June 2022.
examples.solution:
(a) 运出费用（cartage out）是经营费用，不进 COGS；收到的利息是其他收入。B 公司每项都是 A 的 3 倍，所以利润也是 3 倍。
(b) Superquick：费用合计后利润 26 396（与表中一致）；资产负债表上期末资本 = 42 075 + 26 396 − 27 000 = 41 471。银行贷款题目没注明期限，按非流动负债列示。

figures.title: Superquick Couriers Statement of Profit or Loss for the year ended 30 June 2022
Superquick Couriers Statement of Financial Position as at 30 June 2022

mistakes: 运出费用放进 COGS：运出是销售费用。
把应付工资、应付利息漏掉：调整后的 payable 都是流动负债。
资产负债表不平就硬凑：先回头检查净利润和提款。

faqs.q: 资产负债表不平最常见的原因？
faqs.a: 净利润算错、漏了提款、累计折旧方向弄反，或把预收收入当成收入。

rows: 流动 / 非流动资产；流动 / 非流动负债
成本 − 累计折旧 = 账面价值
资本 + 净利润 − 提款
A = L + OE 或 A − L = OE
